title: solarff: NLFFF extrapolations with a calibrated per-line confidence
description:
Python library for the extrapolation of the solar coronal magnetic field from SDO/HMI vector magnetograms (potential, linear force-free and nonlinear force-free), with field-line tracing, a per-line confidence calibrated on exact force-free fields, energy and helicity diagnostics, tests against radiative MHD simulations, and the scripts that reproduce every published result.

Documentation: https://gabgarar.github.io/solarff/
